pages.title: Cornelius Vanguard
pages.text: $(l)Charter Administrator. Status: filing irregular.$()$(br2)Cornelius Vanguard was, until recently, a Charter administrator of standing comparable to Halloran's. His signature appeared on routine dockets across three colonies for eleven years.

The Charter has not, in any public communication, said that Cornelius Vanguard is missing. The Charter has also not, in any public communication, said anything else.$(br2)Senior Foremen note that Vanguard's signature has continued to appear on dockets in colonies he has not, by any survey ship's log, visited.$(br2)Some of the wax is the wrong colour.

It is the Charter's policy that an administrator's filings are presumed valid until audited.$(br2)An audit takes time. Most senior Foremen suspect the audit is, in this case, what Cornelius Vanguard is waiting for.$(br2)Most senior Foremen do not, in writing, say so.
